Pulled both capture sets into the analysis bucket with site and date prefixes, and noted the recycle schedule in the burn-in doc.
The burn-in dashboards can be trimmed as well; keep the loss and retry panels, drop the experimental ones nobody read during the burn-in.
Kept loss and retry, dropped the four experimental panels, and archived their queries in the dashboard folder in case anyone asks.

Wrote the vendor findings into the burn-in doc: the microwave hop degraded under rain fade, and the reroute they applied held for the final two weeks.
The site survey photos from the two worst sites should be linked from the doc too; field ops has them in their drive somewhere.
Linked the survey photo albums from the burn-in doc after field ops shared the folder; both sites' antenna runs are visible in the sets.
Also the burn-in left a temporary retry budget bump on the edge exporters. Confirm whether it is still in place and note where it is set.
The bump is still in place, set in the edge exporter profile; I noted the location and flagged it for review at the next config pass.
The weekly edge sync ran long every week of the burn-in. Now that it is over, propose trimming the standing agenda back to the pre-burn-in shape.
Proposed the trimmed agenda to the edge leads and both agreed; the invite now carries the shorter agenda starting next week.
Field ops asked for a one-page summary of what the burn-in changed for their install checklist; can you draft that from the doc?
Drafted the one-pager: antenna alignment tolerances tightened and the reroute contact added; field ops confirmed it covers their checklist.
And the burn-in spend needs splitting between the network and edge budgets before the month closes; finance flagged the combined line.
Split the spend with the vendor invoices as the dividing line and sent finance the breakdown; both budget owners signed off.
Last: the two loaner spectrum analyzers from the vendor go back this week; make sure the shipping labels and the customs forms are sorted.
Both analyzers are boxed with labels and customs forms attached, and the vendor's return authorization is taped inside the lids.
